title: External tensor sections with affine second factor
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Assume $X$ is quasi-compact, the diagonal of $f$ is affine, and $Y$ is affine. For quasi-coherent module sheaves $F,G$ [pqf-def-coherent], the explicit external tensor map [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison] $\Gamma(X,F)\otimes_k\Gamma(Y,G)\to\Gamma(X\times_kY,\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)$ is bijective.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, equation-kunneth-on-cech; degree-zero finite-cover argument

proof.text: Choose a finite affine cover of X. Its pairwise intersections are affine by the affine-diagonal criterion. On each chart and each overlap, the affine spectrum product, pullback-section, and sheaf-tensor-section comparisons identify the external coefficient sections with F(U) tensor_k G(Y). The pure-tensor formulas give the canonical map and commute with restrictions.

Apply the two sheaf equalizers to the cover of X and its product with Y. Tensor with G(Y) over the field preserves kernels and finite products (Mathlib Module.Flat.ker_lTensor_eq and tensor product finite-product comparisons). Thus the chart isomorphisms restrict to an isomorphism of global sections. Tensor induction and sheaf uniqueness identify it with the explicit external map. Empty schemes and zero modules give zero equalizers.
